# Retained public derivative metadata

These are exact retained public bundle metadata bytes for
`132d59d4692f32c29ff92b7ada5f392c69adc8a14302eae124ceb92f3f685224`
(`umi-community-baseline-v0.2-ft-fsrouter-rc5`). The manifest declares
CC-BY-SA-4.0 and parent
`6fe8df59ec11ba89f4dfe0474a673fe757e378cd9184449965861c5a7c59b641`.
They are retained format fixtures, not executable model payloads or rights
approval. No model weights or private evaluation data are included.

Tests verify the domain-separated bundle digest, each metadata file's declared
hash and size, and apply the actual generation declarations to an inert model
through sealing, runtime verification, warm loading and generation. This does
not establish model latency, quality or deployment readiness.
